subject: SOC2 deliverables, bridge letter request, and auth log slice clarification
messages:
From: Anita Rao <compliance@curohealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:13:00 -0400
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + MFA/access log slice

Hi Vanessa,

Following up from our vendor intake call — CuroHealth is moving Redwood into our data-sensitive vendor cohort and we need a few items to complete our security review and present to our auditors (Blackpine). Can you help with the following by end of day 2026-09-21?

- Final SOC 2 Type II report covering the most recent audit period (PDF)
- A signed bridge letter if the report period does not fully cover our contract start date
- A scoped slice of authentication/access logs to evidence MFA enforcement and access review activity for the period Mar 2026 — Sep 2026 (CSV or S3 upload)
- Point of contact for your auditor (Blackpine) to coordinate any direct evidence pulls or questions

Specific asks from our audit team: MFA enforcement events (success/failure) aggregated by user, privileged access recertification logs, and a short description of how Redwood handles audit log retention and pseudonymization for exported slices.

Can Ben or Grace coordinate delivery of the artifacts? If you expect any of this to require more lead time, let us know and we can discuss a brief extension.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Anita Rao
Security Manager, CuroHealth Systems
compliance@curohealth.com

Attachments: (none)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <compliance@curohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + MFA/access log slice

Hi Anita —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested; outlines below and a couple of clarifying questions so we scope the log slice correctly: 

Planned deliverables (target delivery 2026-09-20):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (official PDF)
- Signed bridge letter (we will use our standard template and can escalate signature if needed)
- Scoped auth/access CSV slice covering 2026-03-01 through 2026-09-01 (we can adjust the end date if you need through 09/18)
- Short write-up describing log retention, pseudonymization approach, and export controls

Clarifications: 
1) For the auth slice, do you need per-username identifiers (email) or pseudonymized IDs? We can provide both but per-user emails require us to process through our data access controls and will add 1 business day.
2) Do you require a specific file format or compression (CSV vs Parquet)?

Ben and Grace — can you confirm you’re OK to own the artifact delivery and let me know any operational constraints (esp. on signed bridge letter turnaround)?

If it helps, I can upload the SOC2 PDF now to a secure drive link and Ben can share the bridge template for signature.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Business Ops — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: (none)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <compliance@curohealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + MFA/access log slice

On Wed, Sep 15, 2026 at 11:02 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben and Grace — can you confirm you’re OK to own the artifact delivery and let me know any operational constraints (esp. on signed bridge letter turnaround)?

Thanks Vanessa — we can own this. Quick timeline and items from our side:

- Today (16 Sep): Upload SOC2 PDF to secure drive and share link with Anita and Blackpine.
- 17 Sep: Prepare signed bridge letter template and initiate DocuSign for an authorized Redwood signee.
- 18 Sep: Prepare scoped auth/access log slice (CSV) and upload to the secure folder; include a README that explains fields and any pseudonymization applied.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (PDF)
- bridge_letter_redwood_signed_template.docx (DOCX)

Notes on the log slice: We will produce a CSV with columns: event_timestamp, pseudonymized_user_id, event_type (mfa_success/mfa_failure/login/privileged_access_review), source_ip (redacted to /24), and reviewer_id for recert events. If CuroHealth requires actual emails rather than pseudonymized_user_id, we can generate a mapped file but that will require additional approvals and likely push the slice to 2026-09-20.

Grace — can you confirm the pseudonymization approach and whether the reviewer_id will be an internal Redwood username or a hashed identifier?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0148
From: Anita Rao <compliance@curohealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, James Hsu <james.hsu@blackpine-audit.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:52:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + MFA/access log slice

Thanks — this plan works for us. A couple of final notes before delivery: 

- For audit purposes Blackpine prefers per-user email identifiers in the log slice. If that will cause a delay, please provide a mapping file alongside the pseudonymized CSV (mapping can be shared under separate secure control).
- We need the signed bridge letter returned via DocuSign; I see the docusign link in your related_links is fine. Please ensure the signer is an officer or CISO-level delegate so our procurement can accept the bridge.
- I will give the Blackpine auditor (James Hsu) permission to the upload folder once you share it. James — I’ve looped you for visibility and you can reach out directly if you need anything else.

On Thu, Sep 16, 2026 at 08:37 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> - 18 Sep: Prepare scoped auth/access log slice (CSV) and upload to the secure folder; include a README that explains fields and any pseudonymization applied.

We are good to receive the artifacts on 18 Sep. Please upload to the Drive folder and drop a short delivery email with file names. If you run into any signing or legal gating on the bridge letter, escalate to Vanessa and I will help.

Best regards,

Anita Rao
Security Manager, CuroHealth Systems
compliance@curohealth.com

Attachments: (none)
